200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully created the exclusion.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The description of the exclusion.
string
The name of the exclusion.
string
The unique UUID of the exclusion.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the creation date of the exclusion.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the last modification date for the
exclusion.
integer
The unique ID of the exclusion.
boolean
Indicates whether core updates are blocked while the exclusion
is active.
object
— 400 Returned if an argument is missing or invalid.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to create an exclusion.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
